definitions.explanation: To adopt or embrace something before others do, or to act in advance of a trend or development. Often used for fashion, trends, and seasonal themes.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}のトレンドを{先取|さきど}りする。
examples.english: Get ahead of the autumn trends.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}を{先取|さきど}りして、{桜|さくら}モチーフの{雑貨|ざっか}が{並|なら}んでいる。
examples.english: Getting ahead of spring, cherry blossom-themed goods are lined up.

examples.japanese: あのブランドはいつも{時代|じだい}を{先取|さきど}りしたデザインで{注目|ちゅうもく}されている。
examples.english: That brand always attracts attention with designs that anticipate the times.

notes:
Very common in fashion, marketing, and lifestyle contexts. Carries a positive nuance of being ahead of the curve.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・トレンドを{先取|さきど}りする (get ahead of trends)
・{季節|きせつ}を{先取|さきど}りする (get a head start on the season)
・{時代|じだい}を{先取|さきど}りする (be ahead of one's time)
・{先取|さきど}り{情報|じょうほう} (advance/preview information)

Frequently appears in magazine headlines and advertising to suggest something is cutting-edge or timely.
